svg.title: L4 Detail -- DFE on AWS, data identities
svg.desc: Three data workloads hold an AWS identity through EKS Pod Identity. ClickHouse writes its parts to its S3 object store, ESO and dfe-engine read and write secrets in Secrets Manager, and the otel collector reads the EKS audit and CloudTrail log groups in CloudWatch.
